title: Frozen Sword in Thorns
description: A silver sword with an ornate crossguard is thrust into the ground, gripped by a skeletal hand emerging from icy blue water. The dark background consists of dense, twisted thorny branches covered in frost and purple webbing, with a large shattered ice formation dominating the right side.
prompt: A silver medieval sword gripped by a skeletal hand rising from icy water, surrounded by a dense tangle of sharp frozen thorns and branches covered in purple webbing and frost. A large shattered ice formation appears on the right. Dark, cold, and desolate atmosphere with dramatic lighting, moody fantasy concept art.
